english.name: Hydra
english.description: Submit a score from a system with 12 or more logical CPU cores.

schinese.name: 九头蛇
schinese.description: 使用拥有 12 个或更多逻辑 CPU 核心的系统提交分数。

english.name: Red Hot
english.description: Can you handle Fire Strike Extreme?

schinese.name: 火热至极
schinese.description: 你能驾驭 Fire Strike Extreme 吗？

english.name: It’s over 9000!!!
english.description: Fire Strike over 9000? There's no way that could be right.

schinese.name: 超过9000了！！！
schinese.description: Fire Strike 分数超过 9000？这肯定不对吧。

english.name: Mystery Machine
english.description: Submit a result using new hardware that isn't recognised by 3DMark.

schinese.name: 神秘机器
schinese.description: 使用 3DMark 无法识别的新硬件提交结果。

english.name: Free PC Upgrade
english.description: Submit a score that is at least 10% higher than your last score.

schinese.name: 免费电脑升级
schinese.description: 提交比上次分数至少高 10% 的分数。

english.name: It's Over 9000, Again!
english.description: Time Spy over 9000? There's (still) no way that could be right.

schinese.name: 又超过9000了！
schinese.description: Time Spy 分数超过 9000？这（还是）肯定不对吧。

english.name: Future Proof
english.description: Windows 10? Check. DirectX 12? Check. Time Spy? Check. Congratulations. You're ready!

schinese.name: 面向未来
schinese.description: Windows 10？有了。DirectX 12？有了。Time Spy？有了。恭喜，你已准备就绪！

english.name: What's the Rush?
english.description: If your Time Spy frame rate is less than 5 FPS, just relax and enjoy the details.

schinese.name: 急什么？
schinese.description: 如果你的 Time Spy 帧率低于 5 FPS，那就放轻松，慢慢欣赏细节吧。

english.name: Rock Solid
english.description: Score 99% or more in the Time Spy Stress Test.

schinese.name: 稳如磐石
schinese.description: 在 Time Spy 压力测试中获得 99% 或更高的分数。

english.name: Interactive
english.description: Spend five minutes in interactive mode in a feature test.

schinese.name: 互动体验
schinese.description: 在功能测试的交互模式中停留五分钟。

english.name: Good
english.description: Achieve a good score for your hardware.

schinese.name: 良好
schinese.description: 为你的硬件取得良好成绩。

english.name: Great
english.description: Achieve a great score for your hardware.

schinese.name: 优秀
schinese.description: 为你的硬件取得优秀成绩。

english.name: Excellent
english.description: Achieve an excellent score for your hardware.

schinese.name: 卓越
schinese.description: 为你的硬件取得卓越成绩。

english.name: Legendary
english.description: Achieve a legendary score for your hardware.

schinese.name: 传奇
schinese.description: 为你的硬件取得传奇成绩。

english.name: Shoot for the Moon
english.description: Achieve a great score or better for your hardware during Lunar New Year.

schinese.name: 志在月球
schinese.description: 在农历新年期间为你的硬件取得优秀或更高成绩。

english.name: No Worries
english.description: Pass a DirectX 12 stress test.

schinese.name: 毫无压力
schinese.description: 通过 DirectX 12 压力测试。

english.name: Lightspeed
english.description: Run Port Royal with an average frame rate greater than 40 FPS.

schinese.name: 光速
schinese.description: 以高于 40 FPS 的平均帧率运行 Port Royal。

english.name: New Year's Resolution
english.description: Run Time Spy Extreme on January 1.

schinese.name: 新年决心
schinese.description: 在 1 月 1 日运行 Time Spy Extreme。

english.name: Night Owl
english.description: Run a benchmark between 00:00 and 06:00.

schinese.name: 夜猫子
schinese.description: 在 00:00 至 06:00 之间运行一次基准测试。

english.name: Integration Nation
english.description: Run a DirectX 12 graphics benchmark using integrated graphics.

schinese.name: 集显国度
schinese.description: 使用集成显卡运行 DirectX 12 图形基准测试。

english.name: 4K Forever
english.description: Run Time Spy Extreme or Fire Strike Ultra.

schinese.name: 永恒4K
schinese.description: 运行 Time Spy Extreme 或 Fire Strike Ultra。

english.name: Future Proof II
english.description: Run all four DirectX 12 Ultimate feature tests.

schinese.name: 面向未来2
schinese.description: 运行全部四项 DirectX 12 Ultimate 功能测试。

english.name: Customize It
english.description: Run a DirectX 12 benchmark with custom settings.

schinese.name: 自定义设置
schinese.description: 以自定义设置运行一次 DirectX 12 基准测试。

english.name: No Sweat
english.description: Keep the GPU temperature under 65 °C for the duration of a DirectX 12 stress test.

schinese.name: 毫不费力
schinese.description: 在 DirectX 12 压力测试的整个过程中，保持 GPU 温度低于65°C。

english.name: Keep a Cool Head
english.description: Keep the CPU temperature below 55 °C during a CPU Profile benchmark run.

schinese.name: 保持冷静头脑
schinese.description: 在 CPU Profile 基准测试运行期间，保持 CPU 温度低于55°C。

english.name: Cool under pressure
english.description: Keep the GPU temperature below 55 °C during a DirectX 12 benchmark run.

schinese.name: 压力之下也冷静
schinese.description: 在 DirectX 12 基准测试运行期间，保持 GPU 温度低于55°C。

english.name: Catchy Tune
english.description: Deliver a result of Steel Nomad with audio.

schinese.name: 悦耳旋律
schinese.description: 在开启音频的情况下运行 Steel Nomad 并取得成绩。

english.name: Steel Explorer
english.description: Use Explorer Mode to discover all secret areas in the world of Steel Nomad with all its hidden treasures.

schinese.name: 钢铁探索者
schinese.description: 使用探索模式，发现 Steel Nomad 世界中的全部秘密区域及其所有隐藏宝藏。

english.name: Sun and Moon
english.description: Run Steel Nomad during the day (06:00 - 18:00), and Steel Nomad Light during the night (18:00 - 06:00).

schinese.name: 日月同辉
schinese.description: 在白天（06:00 - 18:00）运行 Steel Nomad，并在夜间（18:00 - 06:00）运行 Steel Nomad Light。
